notes.title: Alpha & Beta is Getting Free
notes.content:
Hello, in one of my previous announcements i announced that the alpha & beta will be a free game and i am very happy to keep my promise on this subject, the procedures have been completed and it will be free on 1 February 2025.

I would like to briefly explain why i made this decision, first of all i lost the source files of the game and unfortunately i was not able to recover them from the backups. This means that i will not be able to release even a bug fix update in case you encounter a possible bug and i believe that this is not fair. 

Apart from that, there is another reason, to be honest i think my game is an average game, but the idea of ​​publishing a free game did not make much sense, so i chose the lowest price possible, the reason why the idea of ​​publishing a free game does not make sense is that, although it is an average game, Even so, i have put in a good and bad effort and i wanted to be rewarded for this effort, both materially and spiritually. I can said that this is the second reason.

Still, there were people who liked my game and some who didn't. Although i thank those who liked it, i can understand the reason for those who didn't like it. The production phase of this game, the publishing process and the post-publishing process gave me incredible experiences. After my compulsory military service, i will roll up my sleeves for new projects and use the experiences i have gained in my new games. This will probably be the last announcement i will make about this game, stay safe.

notes.title: About Keyboard Not Working Problem
notes.content:
Hello everyone, i recently saw a thread about the keyboard not working, i even realised that the thread was opened quite a long time ago, but since i was in a very chaotic period at that time, i didn't think to see if there was anything new, i would like to make my entry by apologising to here. 

 I explained in another announcement that i had lost access to the source files of the game, so it didn't seem very possible to detect the problem, but when i opened the game and made a few attempts, i noticed something by chance. If you have a gamepad connected to your computer, it automatically transfers the controls to the gamepad and the keyboard is disabled.

 I put a small circle in the upper right corner of the main menu and pause screen so that you can understand this, if the colour of the circle is red, it shows that no gamepad input is detected, and if it is green, it shows that there is a gamepad input. Other than that, I could not find anything that could cause the keyboard not to work, and I did not come across anyone other than the friend who opened the title, i guess thought that the keyboard was not working because had a gamepad connected to his computer. If you think the keyboard inputs are not working, please make sure that there is no gamepad connected to your computer.

notes.title: I Lost the Game's Source Files
notes.content:
Hello all, a long time ago i announced that the alpha & beta will not receive any updates other than bug fix updates, but I lost the source files of the game due to an unfortunate computer failure, and when i tried to restore it from my backup, it gave a warning message that the source file was corrupted. 

 Because of this, i am thinking of making the game completely free, but according to the last information i received, very few people bought it with the winter discounts. In order not to be unfair to the people who bought it, i decided to make it free on a date i have already determined. i will start my initiatives to make the game completely free on 1 February 2024.

If i don't see it even though you write from the discussions section, feel free to use alternative communication channels.

notes.title: About the Earthquake in Turkey
notes.content:
Greetings, maybe you have seen it on the news, there were two earthquakes with a magnitude of over 7 in Kahramanmaraş, Turkey. 10 cities were affected by the earthquake and 3 cities were subjected to great destruction. I am Turkish and I follow the developments with great sadness as I live in Turkey, on the one hand, I see the news of the aid coming from abroad and this situation makes me a little happy. I don't want to talk about these issues too much, but I can't help but say that the economy of the country is really bad and the government unfortunately did not manage the process well.

I'm not in the earthquake zone, likewise, no one in my team is in the earthquake zone, thank God, but unfortunately there are people whose relatives died in my team, my grandmother passed away recently, so I can understand people's pain. The number of deaths and injuries is constantly increasing, the number of destroyed buildings is increasing, I see people who are under the rubble. I also see looters and I get really angry and sad when I see them, it drives me crazy that looters can think about this when people are suffering so much.

I am really happy if those who have the opportunity to donate, i will definitely share the usd, eur and gbp accounts of an institution that i trust, you can also donate on youtube, i will share the link for it

notes.title: Price Update Implemented
notes.content:
Hello again after a long time, I mentioned that the price of alpha & beta will be $1 in my last announcement, even though it has been a while since this announcement, I made the price update, I thought it would be more logical to apply the price update after the discount periods, so the implementation of the new price policy was a bit was late.

I said I would do the DLC for free as well, and I did it right after the announcement. I have to admit, it was a mistake from the very beginning to publish this DLC for a fee, and you are absolutely right in your reactions. I promise you that in my new games, I will not install paid DLC unless it offers really great content.

Let's talk a little bit about my new game, I'm planning to release a demo in April, but because the team members are a bit busy, we can't progress at the speed I want, which probably means the demo will be delayed. I prefer to delay instead of releasing a bad or incomplete demo. The planned release date of the game is the first quarter of 2024, but I cannot say that it will definitely be released on this date at the moment. However, I can say that I believe this game will be a really good game and I am doing my best to present you a good game. I can say that it will be a much more advanced game than Alpha & beta. When I release the demo, I will announce it here. That's all I'm going to say for today, see you when the demo is released.

notes.title: About Pricing
notes.content:
Greetings, I will make a few changes about the pricing of alpha & beta and I would like to inform you about this issue. First of all, let me talk a little about why I made this decision: When I compare today's similar games with my own game, I can say that my game has very simple mechanics and even has the simplicity of mobile games,  while I am working on my new game I can better understand what I'm missing or doing badly in my old game. I'm noticing, so I'll go for an update on pricing. There are also questions about collectible cards, let me answer that one more time. In order to add trading cards, I have to exceed a certain sales limit, but I don't know this limit either, all I know is that I need to sell more. Anyway, back to our topic:

[b]How Alpha & Beta's Pricing Will Be:[/b] The current global price of Alpha & beta is $2, Turkey's price is 5 TL, and very soon the global price will be $1, there will be no country-specific pricing because when I make the global price $1, I will have given the minimum price tag.

[b]About DLC Being Free:[/b] Yes, we will update the price of not only the main game but also the DLC, I would like to give the good news that the DLC will be free. I also received criticism as to why a DLC that only adds a difficulty level is paid, at that time, the idea of ​​​​uploading DLC ​​for free did not seem right to me, so I uploaded the DLC at the minimum price, but some players did not like it, and yes, I can say that they are right. However, I would like to thank everyone who bought and supported my game. To get back from this mistake, I reduce the price of alpha & beta to the minimum level, and I make DLC for free.

I am trying to offer you the best games within my possibilities, I hope you will like and support my work...

notes.title: v1.1.0b Update Released
notes.content:
Hello again after a long time, actually I had no intention of updating to alpha & beta but I posted a small update as I needed to fix an error that was detected and reported to me two days ago. There are many platforms where you can contact me to fix the errors you have detected. The change made:

- Fixed the issue where some thorns did not close and the thorns would go into a weird animation.

In the meantime, let me talk a little about the innovations that I wanted to bring to alpha & beta but could not. I noticed that playing Alpha & beta at 30 fps made it feel like the game was low performance and I wanted to bring 60 fps support, but the game got strangely two times faster. Also i wanted to add nice details such as double bouncing, being thrown, screen shaking when hitting the ground, but I wanted to add these features before. I couldn't add them because I didn't create a proper infrastructure, luckily my new game will have all of these

How about the new game? Tell us a little bit about it?

My new game is still in development, but I am not very interested as I am very busy, but I plan to share a playable demo on itch.io and gamejolt in January 2021. Of course, I set the target release year as 2023. If everything goes well, I plan to release it at the beginning of 2023. My new game will be a metroidvania - rpg mix platform game and you will be able to play the game at 60fps :D also most features without alpha & beta will be available. Some players have said that alpha & beta is extremely difficult, I plan to have many people tested in order to fine-tune the difficulty of the new game. That's all for now, when I release a demo that can be played on itch.io and gamejolt platforms, I'll share it here, stay waiting.

notes.title: v.1.0.4 Update is About
notes.content: Hi everyone, I want to break my long silence and give news from the new update. I will not mention the update in detail, but I will summarize the update with outlines. First of all, we completely renew the background of the game, the new backgrounds are both eye-catching and meticulously prepared to put you in a better atmosphere. I take your feedback into account, and as a result we have changed the way of telling the story. I were aware that reading long texts was boring, and i had some ideas for this, we decided not to wait any longer to make the change. We also had a more beautiful news for you, this beautiful news would be to add the german language, but because of some disputes with the translator we decided to include the german language in the next update, I hope that the next update in the German language players and the German language to play the next game We can get together. In the meantime I heard that you liked the story of the game very much and I am very glad that you like it, and I hope you will love our new storytelling model and wait for our news.
